title: Meter Reading Increment
description: You are managing a digital odometer for a fleet of electric delivery scooters. The odometer's current reading is stored as an array of individual decimal digits, where the most significant digit is at the head of the array and the least significant digit is at the tail. Your task is to implement a function that increments the odometer value by exactly one unit and returns the resulting digit array.
constraints: The odometer reading does not contain any leading zero except for the number 0 itself.
input_format: An array of integers representing the digits of the current odometer reading.
output_format: An array of integers representing the digits after incrementing by one.

examples.explanation: The reading is 123. Incrementing by one gives 124.
The reading is 439. Incrementing by one results in a carry, turning it into 440.
The reading is 9. Incrementing by one causes a rollover to 10.
